def calc(num, length):
    p = [0] * 17
    if p[1] == 0:
        for i in range(1, 17):
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1
    if length == 0:
        return 0
    baseVal = p[length]
    quotient = num // baseVal
    remainder = num % baseVal
    total = quotient * length
    if remainder != 0:
        option1 = calc(remainder, length - 1)
        option2 = length + calc(baseVal - remainder, length - 1)
        total += min(option1, option2)
    return total

n = int(input())
